lines.text: You have laid me in the lowest Pit,
in the darkest of the depths.
Your wrath weighs heavily upon me;
all Your waves have submerged me.
You have removed my friends from me;
You have made me repulsive to them;
I am confined and cannot escape.
My eyes grow dim with grief.
I call to You daily, O LORD;
I spread out my hands to You.
Do You work wonders for the dead?
Do departed spirits rise up to praise You?
Can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave,
Will Your wonders be known in the darkness,
or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, La Grotte de la Loue — the black mouth of the cave in the rock, who are cut off from Your care, You have laid me in the lowest Pit
pictures.name: pd_courbet_grotte

pictures.scene: Jacob Maris, Steinerne Mühle — the mill standing under a heavy sky with the light almost gone, in the darkest of the depths, Your wrath weighs heavily upon me
pictures.name: pd_maris_molen

pictures.scene: Winslow Homer, The Gulf Stream — the dismasted boat with the sea breaking clean over it, all Your waves have submerged me
pictures.name: pd_homer_gulf

pictures.scene: Jules Bastien-Lepage, The Beggar — the ragged old man turned away at the door, You have removed my friends from me, You have made me repulsive to them
pictures.name: pd_bastien_mendiant

pictures.scene: Nikolai Yaroshenko, The Prisoner — the man at the barred window of his cell, I am confined and cannot escape, my eyes grow dim with grief
pictures.name: pd_yaroshenko_zaklyuchenny

pictures.scene: Harriet Backer, Christening in Tanum Church — the people gathered under the daylight of the windows, I call to You daily O LORD, I spread out my hands to You
pictures.name: pd_backer_tanum

pictures.scene: Émile Friant, La Toussaint — the mourners filing to the graves on All Saints' Day, do You work wonders for the dead, do departed spirits rise up to praise You
pictures.name: pd_friant_toussaint

pictures.scene: Jacob Maris, Stadsgezicht — the grey town standing silent over its water, can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave
pictures.name: pd_maris_stadsgezicht

pictures.scene: Ralph Albert Blakelock, Moonlight — the trees swallowed in darkness with one small light behind them, Your faithfulness in Abaddon, will Your wonders be known in the darkness
pictures.name: pd_blakelock_moonlight

pictures.scene: Peder Balke, Træ i vinterskov — the bare tree alone in the white emptiness, or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion, but to You O LORD I cry for help
pictures.name: pd_balke_vinterskov
